proposals.label: Thoracentesis
proposals.rationale: Adopt separately because single-session pleural aspiration is clinically distinct from a drain left in place.
proposals.definition: Percutaneous aspiration or drainage of pleural fluid with a needle or temporary catheter.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for needle or temporary-catheter aspiration of pleural fluid.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude an indwelling drain left for ongoing evacuation; use chest-tube or indwelling-pleural-catheter as appropriate.

proposals.label: Chest tube
proposals.rationale: Adopt separately because ongoing tube drainage is not equivalent to thoracentesis or a tunneled indwelling catheter.
proposals.definition: Tube thoracostomy or small-bore pleural catheter drainage left in place for ongoing evacuation.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for tube thoracostomy or small-bore pleural drainage maintained after insertion.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude single-session pleural aspiration and tunneled long-term catheters.

proposals.label: Pleurodesis
proposals.rationale: Adopt a procedure-level term that covers talc and other pleurodesis methods without encoding a specific agent.
proposals.definition: Chemical or mechanical pleural symphysis intended to prevent recurrent pleural fluid or air.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for chemical or mechanical attempts to create pleural symphysis.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude drainage alone and indwelling pleural catheter placement without pleurodesis.

proposals.label: Bronchoalveolar lavage
proposals.rationale: Adopt because BAL is a recurrent sampling technique and should not be inferred from generic flexible bronchoscopy.
proposals.definition: Bronchoalveolar lavage performed through a bronchoscope for diagnostic sampling or therapeutic clearance.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when bronchoalveolar lavage is a named diagnostic sampling or therapeutic technique.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude generic bronchoscopy, bronchial washing, and whole-lung lavage.

proposals.label: Conventional TBNA
proposals.rationale: Adopt because landmark-guided TBNA is not automatically convex EBUS-TBNA.
proposals.definition: Non-ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration using anatomic landmarks.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for landmark-guided TBNA performed without real-time convex EBUS guidance.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude convex EBUS-TBNA and EUS-B-FNA.

proposals.label: Rapid on-site evaluation
proposals.rationale: Adopt as a specimen-assessment workflow rather than treating ROSE as a biopsy needle or imaging technology.
proposals.definition: Immediate on-site cytologic assessment of procedural specimens to evaluate adequacy or guide further sampling.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when immediate cytology review is used to assess specimen adequacy or guide additional sampling.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude routine final cytopathology and biopsy-device descriptions without on-site assessment.

proposals.label: Endobronchial coils
proposals.rationale: Adopt because coil implantation is a distinct bronchoscopic lung-volume-reduction technology.
proposals.definition: Endobronchial coil implantation for bronchoscopic lung-volume reduction.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for implanted bronchoscopic coils intended for lung-volume reduction.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude endobronchial valves, vapor ablation, and surgical lung-volume reduction.

proposals.label: Balloon bronchoplasty
proposals.rationale: Adopt because dilation is a distinct airway intervention and does not imply stent placement.
proposals.definition: Balloon dilation of a tracheal or bronchial narrowing.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for balloon dilation of tracheal or bronchial stenosis.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude airway stenting unless a stent is separately placed or studied.

proposals.label: Mediastinal cryobiopsy
proposals.rationale: Adopt separately because EBUS-guided mediastinal cryobiopsy is not transbronchial lung cryobiopsy.
proposals.definition: Cryoprobe tissue acquisition from mediastinal or hilar lymph nodes or masses, typically through an EBUS-guided tract.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for cryobiopsy of a mediastinal or hilar node or mass through an airway or EBUS-created tract.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude transbronchial lung or peripheral-lesion cryobiopsy.
examples: Cryobiopsy of a mediastinal lymph node

proposals.label: Foreign-body removal
proposals.rationale: Adopt as a treatment technology distinct from the foreign-body-aspiration disease tag.
proposals.definition: Bronchoscopic extraction of an aspirated or retained airway foreign body.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for bronchoscopic extraction of an aspirated or retained airway object.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude the disease or presentation alone when no removal procedure is described.

proposals.label: Bronchial artery embolization
proposals.rationale: Adopt because endovascular embolization is distinct from bronchoscopic hemostatic treatment.
proposals.definition: Endovascular embolization of bronchial or systemic arteries to control hemoptysis.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for endovascular bronchial or systemic arterial embolization undertaken for hemoptysis.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude bronchoscopic topical or ablative hemostasis.
examples: Bronchial artery embolization for massive hemoptysis

proposals.label: Narrow-band imaging
proposals.rationale: Adopt separately because NBI uses filtered illumination and is not interchangeable with autofluorescence imaging.
proposals.definition: Narrow-band optical imaging used during bronchoscopy to enhance mucosal and vascular patterns.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when narrow-band imaging is employed to examine airway mucosa or vasculature.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude white-light bronchoscopy, autofluorescence imaging, and confocal endomicroscopy.

proposals.label: Autofluorescence bronchoscopy
proposals.rationale: Adopt separately because autofluorescence is a stable optical-imaging class distinct from NBI.
proposals.definition: Autofluorescence imaging used during bronchoscopy to identify abnormal airway mucosa.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when autofluorescence imaging is employed to detect or characterize airway mucosal abnormalities.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude narrow-band imaging and white-light bronchoscopy alone.

proposals.label: Confocal laser endomicroscopy
proposals.rationale: Adopt the supported confocal modality while keeping optical coherence tomography separate and deferred.
proposals.definition: Probe-based or needle-based confocal laser endomicroscopy used for microscopic in-vivo imaging.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for probe-based or needle-based confocal microscopic imaging during pulmonary or pleural procedures.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude optical coherence tomography and other optical imaging without confocal microscopy.
examples: Probe-based CLE of a peripheral lesion

proposals.label: Topical hemostatic agent
proposals.rationale: Adopt because topical airway hemostasis is not automatically laser, electrocautery, or APC.
proposals.definition: Topically delivered airway hemostatic material or drug used to control endobronchial bleeding.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for a named topical material or medication applied endobronchially to control bleeding.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude laser, electrocautery, APC, balloon tamponade, and systemic hemostatic therapy.

proposals.label: Transbronchial thermal ablation
proposals.rationale: Adopt for bronchoscopic tumor-directed thermal ablation, distinct from bronchial thermoplasty.
proposals.definition: Thermal tumor ablation delivered through a bronchoscopic or transbronchial access path.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for microwave, radiofrequency, or comparable thermal ablation delivered through a bronchoscopic access path.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude bronchial thermoplasty, nonthermal pulsed-field ablation, and percutaneous or surgical ablation.

proposals.label: Surgical VATS
proposals.rationale: Adopt to prevent surgical VATS from being conflated with physician-performed medical thoracoscopy.
proposals.definition: Video-assisted thoracic surgery used as an adjacent surgical procedure, comparator, or procedural analogue.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for video-assisted thoracic surgery when represented as an adjacent procedure, comparator, or analogue.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude medical thoracoscopy and bronchoscopic procedures.

proposals.label: Thoracentesis / chest tube
proposals.rationale: The source proposal conflates two procedures; preserve both canonical terms and require row-level evidence to select one or both.
proposals.definition: A combined source proposal covering both single-session pleural aspiration and ongoing tube drainage.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use only as a migration-source label for rows mentioning thoracentesis or chest-tube drainage.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Do not emit this combined value in v2 artifacts.

proposals.label: Pleurodesis agent
proposals.rationale: The canonical v2 procedure term is agent-neutral and covers talc or another chemical or mechanical pleurodesis method.
proposals.definition: A source label for an agent or method used to create pleural symphysis.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Map when the source denotes pleurodesis rather than drainage alone.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Do not infer a specific agent when the evidence states only pleurodesis.

proposals.label: Balloon dilation
proposals.rationale: Balloon bronchoplasty is the canonical airway-specific label for this exact procedural concept.
proposals.definition: Balloon dilation of a tracheal or bronchial narrowing.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Map when the source describes airway balloon dilation or bronchoplasty.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude vascular, esophageal, or other non-airway balloon dilation.

proposals.label: Split transbronchial cryobiopsy
proposals.rationale: This is a schema-change proposal, not an emittable tag; retain lung cryobiopsy and add mediastinal cryobiopsy as distinct canonicals.
proposals.definition: A source proposal to disambiguate lung or peripheral cryobiopsy from mediastinal nodal cryobiopsy.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use only to plan migration of rows carrying the former broad cryobiopsy tag.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Do not emit this planning label in v2 artifacts or select a replacement without row evidence.

proposals.label: Optical coherence tomography
proposals.rationale: The located QA evidence combines OCT with confocal endomicroscopy and does not supply enough independently adjudicated OCT use to establish a stable v2 term.
proposals.definition: Optical cross-sectional tissue imaging based on low-coherence interferometry.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Would include bronchoscopic OCT used to characterize airway or pulmonary tissue.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Would exclude confocal laser endomicroscopy and generic CT imaging.

proposals.label: Cost-effectiveness and health services
proposals.rationale: Adopt because economic and care-pathway objectives are recurrent and should not be hidden under a general overview.
proposals.definition: Evaluating costs, value, utilization, access, care pathways, or service delivery.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when costs, value, utilization, access, care pathways, or service delivery are primary objectives.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude clinical outcome studies that do not evaluate a health-services or economic objective.

proposals.label: Specimen adequacy
proposals.rationale: Adopt because specimen sufficiency is a distinct objective spanning cytology, histology, and molecular testing.
proposals.definition: Evaluating whether a specimen is sufficient for cytology, histology, biomarker, or molecular testing.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when adequacy for diagnosis, histology, cytology, biomarkers, or molecular testing is a primary objective.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude diagnostic-yield reporting that does not assess specimen sufficiency or processing.

sources.source_term: performance monitoring of an EBUS service

proposals.label: Workflow, operations, and quality
proposals.rationale: Adopt because operational and quality objectives recur independently of training or broad clinical overview.
proposals.definition: Evaluating procedural workflow, service operations, quality improvement, or program performance.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when workflow, operational performance, quality improvement, or program delivery is a primary objective.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude training-only work and general overviews without a defined operational or quality aim.
examples: Quality metrics for an interventional pulmonology program

proposals.label: Lymphoma or hematologic malignancy
proposals.rationale: Adopt because hematologic malignancies are not primary lung cancer and recur in mediastinal diagnostic studies.
proposals.definition: Lymphoid, leukemic, plasma-cell, or other hematologic malignancy involving thoracic structures.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for lymphoma, leukemia, plasma-cell, or other hematologic malignancy involving thoracic structures.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude primary lung carcinoma and extrathoracic solid-tumor metastases.

proposals.label: Metastatic extrathoracic malignancy
proposals.rationale: Adopt to distinguish an extrathoracic primary with thoracic metastasis from primary lung carcinoma.
proposals.definition: Thoracic, airway, lung, or pleural involvement by a primary malignancy arising outside the thorax.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when a solid malignancy arising outside the thorax metastasizes to lung, airway, lymph node, or pleura.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude primary lung cancer and hematologic malignancy.

proposals.label: Tracheobronchomalacia or EDAC
proposals.rationale: Adopt because dynamic expiratory collapse is not fixed benign airway stenosis.
proposals.definition: Dynamic expiratory collapse caused by airway-wall weakness or excessive invagination of the posterior membrane.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for dynamic expiratory central-airway collapse due to malacia or excessive posterior-membrane invagination.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude fixed benign airway stenosis and transient collapse without a TBM or EDAC diagnosis.

proposals.label: Asthma
proposals.rationale: Adopt the disease independently from its bronchial-thermoplasty treatment technology.
proposals.definition: Asthma, including severe asthma evaluated for bronchial thermoplasty.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for studies whose clinical population or disease focus is asthma.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude other obstructive airway diseases without asthma.
examples: Severe asthma treated with bronchial thermoplasty

proposals.label: Foreign-body aspiration
proposals.rationale: Adopt the clinical condition independently from the removal procedure.
proposals.definition: Aspiration or retention of a foreign object in the tracheobronchial tree.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for aspiration or retention of a foreign object in the airway.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Do not use solely because a removal device is discussed without foreign-body disease or presentation.

proposals.label: Hemoptysis
proposals.rationale: Adopt the clinical bleeding problem independently from bronchoscopic or endovascular hemostatic treatment.
proposals.definition: Coughing or expectoration of blood arising from the lower respiratory tract.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when lower-respiratory bleeding or hemoptysis is a clinical problem or diagnosis.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Do not use solely for procedural bleeding prophylaxis or a hemostatic technology without hemoptysis.

proposals.label: Bronchiectasis
proposals.rationale: Adopt because bronchiectasis recurs as a disease context and has no exact v1 equivalent.
proposals.definition: Chronic abnormal bronchial dilation and its complications.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for studies whose clinical population or disease focus is bronchiectasis.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude isolated airway dilation not diagnosed as bronchiectasis.

proposals.label: Pulmonary alveolar proteinosis
proposals.rationale: Adopt the disease separately from the existing whole-lung-lavage treatment tag; the located QA tables did not provide an independent keyword count.
proposals.definition: Alveolar accumulation of surfactant material characteristic of pulmonary alveolar proteinosis.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for autoimmune, hereditary, secondary, or other pulmonary alveolar proteinosis.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude other alveolar-filling diseases.

proposals.label: Airway amyloidosis
proposals.rationale: Adopt because localized airway amyloid is a specific recurrent airway disorder rather than a generic immune-inflammatory label.
proposals.definition: Localized or systemic amyloid deposition affecting the tracheobronchial tree.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when amyloid deposition affects the trachea or bronchi.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude amyloidosis without airway involvement.

sources.source_term: pulmonary artery sling with congenital airway symptoms
subglottic stenosis in infants and children

proposals.label: Congenital airway disorder
proposals.rationale: Adopt for congenital structural airway disorders that should not be collapsed into acquired fixed stenosis.
proposals.definition: A structural or developmental airway abnormality present from birth.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for congenital structural or developmental abnormalities of the trachea or bronchi.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude acquired stenosis, malacia without congenital attribution, and congenital parenchymal disease without airway involvement.

proposals.label: Cross-sectional survey
proposals.rationale: Adopt to distinguish quantitative survey or point-in-time measurement from qualitative research.
proposals.definition: A quantitative survey or cross-sectional measurement of a defined population at one period.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for quantitative survey or cross-sectional data collected at one period without longitudinal follow-up.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude interview-based thematic research and cohorts defined by follow-up over time.

proposals.label: Economic evaluation
proposals.rationale: Adopt for formal economic comparisons rather than general health-services observation.
proposals.definition: A formal comparison of costs, consequences, or value across care strategies.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for cost-effectiveness, cost-utility, cost-benefit, budget-impact, or decision-analytic economic comparisons.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude general health-services observations that report resource use without a formal economic evaluation.

proposals.label: Bench or in-vitro study
proposals.rationale: Adopt for bench, phantom, cadaveric, ex-vivo, and in-vitro work distinct from clinical technical notes.
proposals.definition: A laboratory, phantom, cadaveric, ex-vivo, or in-vitro technical experiment without living human participants.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for laboratory, phantom, cadaveric, ex-vivo, or in-vitro experiments without living human participants.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude in-vivo animal studies and clinical technical notes describing patient care.

proposals.label: Animal preclinical study
proposals.rationale: Adopt for in-vivo nonhuman animal work distinct from bench or in-vitro testing.
proposals.definition: An in-vivo experiment conducted in nonhuman animals before or outside clinical evaluation.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for in-vivo experiments in nonhuman animals.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude isolated tissue, ex-vivo organs, phantoms, and other bench or in-vitro testing.

proposals.label: Qualitative study
proposals.rationale: Adopt for thematic interview, focus-group, observation, or qualitative text analysis.
proposals.definition: Research using interviews, focus groups, observation, or qualitative text analysis to develop themes or explanations.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for research based primarily on interviews, focus groups, observation, or qualitative coding and thematic analysis.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude structured quantitative questionnaires analyzed as cross-sectional surveys.

proposals.label: Case-control study
proposals.rationale: Adopt for outcome-selected cases and controls, distinct from exposure-selected retrospective cohorts.
proposals.definition: An observational comparison selecting participants by outcome or case status and examining prior exposures or characteristics.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when cases and controls are selected by outcome or case status and prior exposures or characteristics are compared.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude retrospective cohorts selected by exposure or intervention and followed to outcomes.
examples: Cases with a complication compared with matched controls

proposals.label: Adjacent procedural scope boundary
proposals.rationale: The candidate is too broad and boundary-oriented to be a stable content topic; the narrower surgical/procedural analogue topic covers the evidenced cases.
proposals.definition: A proposed catch-all topic for adjacent procedures that inform interventional pulmonology.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Would include adjacent non-IP procedures with a direct comparator or translational relationship.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Would exclude merely off-topic procedures and established narrower v2 topics.
examples: Surgical comparator to a bronchoscopic procedure

proposals.label: Adjacent surgical and procedural analogues
proposals.rationale: Adopt as the defensible path for surgical comparators and analogues without mislabeling them as bronchoscopic procedures.
proposals.definition: Surgical or nonbronchoscopic procedures used as comparators, alternatives, or technical analogues for interventional pulmonology without being bronchoscopic interventions themselves.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for surgical or nonbronchoscopic procedures when they are relevant as comparators, alternatives, or technical analogues to interventional pulmonology.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude articles whose primary intervention is bronchoscopic; classify those under the corresponding bronchoscopic topic instead.
examples: Surgical lung-volume reduction compared with bronchoscopic lung-volume reduction
VATS localization or resection used as an adjacent procedural comparator

proposals.label: Specimen adequacy and molecular pathology
proposals.rationale: Adopt because specimen adequacy and downstream molecular pathology recur across procedure families.
proposals.definition: Cytology, histopathology, biomarker, and molecular-testing adequacy of specimens obtained during pulmonary or pleural procedures.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use when specimen sufficiency, processing, cytology or histopathology yield, biomarkers, or molecular testing is a primary focus.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude studies reporting only diagnostic yield without evaluating specimen quality, processing, or downstream pathology testing.
examples: Adequacy of EBUS-TBNA specimens for molecular profiling
Cytology workflow and biomarker sufficiency after bronchoscopic biopsy

proposals.label: Upper-airway and anesthesia boundary
proposals.rationale: The current safety, anesthesia, and complications root already provides the stable boundary; no independently recurrent narrower category was established.
proposals.definition: A proposed boundary category for anesthesia and upper-airway considerations adjacent to bronchoscopy.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Map anesthesia, ventilation, and procedural-safety content to the existing safety topic when in IP scope.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude unrelated upper-airway disease or anesthesia outside the procedural scope.

proposals.label: Health services and economics
proposals.rationale: Adopt because economics, access, utilization, workflow, and program delivery form a recurrent scope distinct from education.
proposals.definition: Care delivery, workflow, operations, quality, utilization, access, costs, and economic evaluation related to interventional pulmonary services.
proposals.inclusion_boundary: Use for interventional pulmonary care delivery, operations, access, utilization, quality, program outcomes, costs, or formal economic evaluation.
proposals.exclusion_boundary: Exclude purely clinical efficacy or safety studies without a health-services, operational, quality, or economic objective.
examples: Operational outcomes after establishing an interventional pulmonology service

migration_mappings.rationale: The source value combines two distinct procedures; row-level evidence must determine one or both replacements.
Agent-specific wording maps to the agent-neutral canonical procedure without changing row meaning.
Within the airway technology field, balloon dilation is an exact alias for balloon bronchoplasty.
Existing rows require source review to distinguish lung or peripheral cryobiopsy from mediastinal nodal cryobiopsy.
OCT remains deferred and has no supported canonical replacement.
The QA source combines two optical modalities; row evidence must select one or both.
Only confocal endomicroscopy is adopted; rows require review because OCT remains deferred.
Normalize British spelling and make the broader hematologic-malignancy scope explicit.
The expanded canonical ID preserves the same extrathoracic metastatic-malignancy concept.
The v2 canonical groups the closely related dynamic central-airway-collapse terms TBM and EDAC.
Normalize British spelling without changing meaning.
The broad candidate is deferred; only independently reviewed surgical-analogue rows may use the narrower adopted topic.
